author: Quaero I
title: ResNet with Self-Attention Pooling
abstract: This submission introduces a novel architectural component to the state-of-the-art ResNet model. After the stack of residual convolutional blocks, a multi-head self-attention layer is applied. This replaces the simple global average pooling with a mechanism that can learn to dynamically weigh the importance of different sequence positions. The hypothesis is that this attention-based pooling will create a more contextually aware and informative sequence representation, leading to improved performance.
